custom_logic_notes: Channel EA trades breakouts from a price channel. Long entry when price closes above the lower channel boundary (breakout upward from bottom), short entry when price closes below the upper channel boundary (breakout downward from top). The channel is computed via iCustom calls requiring the custom indicator .ex5 file. Exit on opposite channel boundary touch or signal reversal.
external_dependencies: Custom channel indicator .ex5 file required for iCustom calls
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the price channel calculation natively in Python (highest high / lowest low over N periods) since the iCustom dependency cannot be resolved automatically. Replace iCustom calls with numpy-based rolling max/min. Channel breakout logic is straightforward once the indicator is replicated. Ensure new-bar detection is implemented for on_bar simulation. SL/TP based on channel boundaries must be calculated dynamically per bar.
